payload.title: Prioritize actionable candidates under semantic diagnosis caps
payload.description:
As an operator, I want a bounded semantic-diagnosis budget to prioritize actionable optimization candidates, so that known structural blockers do not consume the only model-backed slot while launchable candidates remain unreviewed.

Feature: Actionable semantic diagnosis ordering
Scenario: A structurally blocked evidence leader does not consume a scarce diagnosis slot
  Given the highest evidence-ranked score has a deterministic missing or invalid rubric blocker
  And a lower evidence-ranked score is structurally ready for semantic diagnosis and possible optimization
  And the run permits one semantic diagnosis
  When the portfolio selects its semantic diagnosis scope
  Then it selects the structurally ready score
  And it keeps the blocked score visible with its original evidence rank and repair action
  And it does not spend semantic budget re-proving the known mechanical blocker

Scenario: Actionable candidates retain evidence order
  Given multiple structurally ready candidates
  When a bounded semantic diagnosis scope is selected
  Then selected candidates retain their original evidence ranking order

Out of scope: changing the evidence ranking metric, hiding blocked scores, automatic promotion, or increasing caller budgets.
